label: PF Backlog 644
title: EDP-16 follow-ups: bounded scan, local lock shards, real consumers

brief.problem: EDP-16 shipped libraries with no bounded scan, unbounded lock map and no consumers.
brief.what_adds: PrefixLister-based paged scan, 64 shard locks, objreconcile CLI and admin signed-URL route.
brief.why_now: These were the three must-fix residuals from the post-merge review.
brief.success: Drift scan never materialises the full bucket listing; local locks are bounded; ops can run the CLI and mint URLs.

objective: Close the three must-fix EDP-16 residuals: bounded reconciliation scan, bounded local locks, and real entrypoints (CLI + signed-URL route).
acceptance_criteria: objreconcile Scan is memory-bounded: it consumes pages via an optional PrefixLister (page size 1000, MaxObjects cap) and never materialises the full listing; local and S3 implement ListPage.
LocalStore key locks are a fixed shard pool (64 mutexes) so long-lived processes cannot grow an unbounded per-key map.

A real consumer ships: go/objreconcile/cmd/objreconcile scans a manifest JSON file and exits non-zero on drift; edpsvc exposes an admin-only GET /admin/objects/url that mints signed URLs via objpolicy with the authenticated tenant context.
Tests cover pagination, shard locks, CLI report/exit codes and the URL route validation.
in_scope: EDP-16 follow-ups: bounded scan, local lock shards, real consumers
approach: EDP-16 follow-ups: bounded scan, local lock shards, real consumers

assumptions: admin token is the authenticated principal

impact_review.claim: Bounded scan needs a paginated listing primitive
CLI is the reconcile job entrypoint

verification: Objective achieved: EDP-16 follow-ups: bounded scan, local lock shards, real consumers
summary: EDP-16 follow-ups: bounded scan, shard locks, CLI + signed-URL route.

api_impact.reason: one admin-only signed-URL mint endpoint; tenant from admin-authenticated request + WithTenant
